title: Rocket Artillery in my Mongolian Invasion of Vietnam hero defense game
author: Ok-Pirate5732
selftext:
Did the Mongolians successfully incorporate early gunpowder technology from the Song Dynasty into their military? Yes

Is there any evidence they brought a rocket wagon like this when they invaded Vietnam in 1287? not a whole lot, but it looks cool lol 

I've been tinkering with sprinkling in some Mongolian artillery for some waves to flip the typical defense script and force the players out from behind the walls, towers, traps, etc. that they can build.

Still a WIP and a good deal of tweaking to do, but let me know what you think! 

A demo for [100 Bodies in the Grass ](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5357660/100_Bodies_in_the_Grass/)is also planned for next Monday, so please feel free to wishlist us if you are interested!
